header.account: A US criminal and traffic defense law firm

sources.source: Google Ads (campaigns, responsive search ads, line results, search terms)

sources.detail: no Meta ad account is connected for this business
headings, meta tags and brand extractor all failed (HTTP 400 'Error fetching URL'; ERR_CONNECTION_RESET); the same calls on a public control page failed the same way, so the crawler itself was down
the Meta Ad Library search failed (ERR_CONNECTION_RESET), and the Google Transparency search returned no advertisers even for a household-name domain, so the fetch failed

line_baseline.from: 2 enabled responsive search ads, 4686 impressions, 61.0 conversions

what_the_data_says.google_ratings: all 34 lines are rated PENDING by Google, so the grades below come from the line results only

lines.text: We Fight All Types of Drug Possession Charges – Aggressive Drug Crime Defense.
Some of the most experienced lawyers, offering representation across the entire state
Call Now if you have been arrested for possession of a controlled substance in [State].
[N]+ 5-Star Reviews. [N]+ Charges Resolved. [N]+ Yrs of Experience. Get Help Soon
We Fight to Keep Your Freedom

what_it_means: The two offer lines (case evaluation, payment plans) and the 'just arrested, call now' description beat the campaign; they carry the briefs.
Place lines grade 0.88x at best, although place words fill the search terms (193 terms): people say where they are, but the firm's location alone doesn't win more leads.

Number-based proof lines (reviews, charges resolved, years) each had under 500 impressions (2.85x, 2.05x, 1.32x, 0.0x on that little traffic). The one adjective proof line, 'Some of the most experienced lawyers, offering representation across the entire state', ran at scale (2216 impressions) and graded weak (0.76x). Specific numbers are untested at scale, so they are the exploration brief.

customer_themes.visible_share: 14.3 of 61.0 conversions (23%) and 48 of 212 clicks are in visible search terms; themes describe only that part

pick_rule: top 2 non-exploration angles by score, plus the best exploration angle; ties go to the higher conversions per 1,000 impressions on the angle's best line

briefs.angle: Talk to a lawyer before you pay anything

overview.purpose: The first step costs nothing: a case evaluation.
overview.why_now: the account's best Search messages, rebuilt for Meta
overview.success_in_one_sentence: More calls from new prospects at a cost per lead the firm can afford.

audience.who: Adults in the state facing a criminal charge, or a family member searching for them
audience.problem: a charge, an arrest or a court date, and not knowing what happens next
barriers: whether this firm is any good
their_words: affordable criminal defense attorney near me
good criminal defense lawyers near me
audience.insight: People search the cost and the charge, not the law firm: answer those two first.

messaging_hierarchy.content: The first step costs nothing: a case evaluation.
Call now (the ads' own action; confirm the landing page asks for a call)

claims_we_can_make: Case evaluation at no cost (in the account's ads)
Flexible payment plans (in the account's ads)
claims_to_avoid: Any promise of an outcome (charges dropped, case won, no jail)
Past results without the disclaimer your state bar requires
'Expert', 'specialist' or 'best' unless your state bar allows it and you can back it
Client testimonials or faces without written permission and any required disclaimer
Anything the landing page does not also say (page not checked in this run: confirm)

creative_direction.tone_of_voice: calm and direct, like a lawyer on the phone the night of an arrest; plain words, no legal jargon, no fear tactics
creative_direction.colours_and_fonts: to fill: the landing page could not be crawled in this run
like_this: One large line of text on a plain background, with the call button visible
A real person speaking to camera in an office, captioned
not_like_this: Gavels, scales of justice and stock courtroom photos
Handcuffs or mugshot imagery that shames the viewer

static_module.message: No-cost case review. Call now. (the hook; the same words go on the image)
static_module.layout: hook at the top third, proof line under it, call button area clear at the bottom

outline.content: the problem in the viewer's words: affordable defense attorney near me; affordable criminal defense attorney near me
The first step costs nothing: a case evaluation.
Call now, with the number on screen

video_module.must_show: the phone number and the call button area, on screen for the last 3 s
video_module.scripted_vs_ad_lib: the hook and the call to action word for word; the problem and the answer in the speaker's own words
video_module.audio: a calm voiceover by a lawyer from the firm; no music or low music
